# ULTRATHINK-GO

# THIS REPO HAS BEEN GENERATED BY CLAUDE CODE
Real-time agent feed monitor designed for Claude Code development workflows.

![ULTRATHINK Interface](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active-green) ![Go Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.23+-blue) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)

## What it does

ULTRATHINK shows what Claude Code is doing in a repository. You start it in the repository, open the page in a browser, and each commit and each change to TODO.md shows up as an entry in a feed.

Each entry has three parts: intent, change and result.

- Commit: the commit message (cut at 80 characters), the changed files, and `success`.
- TODO.md: the first line that is not empty and not a heading, and `updated`.

The page also shows the current objective (read from TODO.md when the page loads) and has a filter for commits or TODO entries. Click "Modified N files" to see the files of a commit, and click "TODO.md" in an entry to read the file.

## Install

You need Go 1.23 or newer.

```bash
go install github.com/NessimBenA/ULTRATHINK-GO@latest
```

This builds a binary named `ULTRATHINK-GO` and puts it in `$(go env GOPATH)/bin`, or in `$GOBIN` if you set it. That directory must be on your `PATH`.

The web UI is embedded in the binary, so it works from any directory.

To build from source instead:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/NessimBenA/ULTRATHINK-GO.git
cd ULTRATHINK-GO
make build
```

This gives you `./ultrathink`.

## Usage

Start it from the root of the repository you want to watch:

```bash
cd /path/to/your/repo
ULTRATHINK-GO
```

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8080.

It watches the directory you start it from:

- Git HEAD, checked once per second. When HEAD points to a new commit, that commit becomes an entry. The first entry is the commit HEAD points to at startup.
- TODO.md. Each time the file is written, created or replaced, it becomes an entry. The file does not need to exist when you start ULTRATHINK.

If the directory is not a git repository, you only get TODO.md entries.

ULTRATHINK does not create or change any file in that directory.

The server keeps the last 100 events in memory and sends them to each page that connects, so a tab you open later still shows the recent history.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Meaning |
|------|---------|---------|
| `-addr` | `127.0.0.1:8080` | Address to listen on, as `host:port`. |

The `PORT` environment variable changes the port of the default address: `PORT=3000 ULTRATHINK-GO` listens on `127.0.0.1:3000`. `-addr` takes precedence over `PORT`.

```bash
ULTRATHINK-GO -addr 127.0.0.1:3000
ULTRATHINK-GO -addr 0.0.0.0:8080
```

## Security defaults

The feed shows your TODO.md, commit messages and file names, and there is no login. The defaults keep it on your machine:

- It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so other machines cannot connect. To allow them, pass an address such as `-addr 0.0.0.0:8080`. Anyone who can reach that address can then read the feed.
- The WebSocket only accepts connections from its own page: when the browser sends an `Origin` header, it must match the `Host` header. Other websites you visit cannot open the feed.
- Requests get a 403 unless the `Host` header is `localhost` or an IP address. This blocks DNS rebinding, where a website points its own domain name at 127.0.0.1 to get around the origin check. If you listen on another address, open the page by its IP address, not by a host name.

## Claude Code integration

1. Copy CLAUDE.md from this repository into yours, or merge its rules into your own. It tells Claude Code to keep its steps in TODO.md and to commit each file change on its own.
2. Start ULTRATHINK in your repository and open the page.
3. Ask Claude Code for a change and watch it update TODO.md and commit, step by step.

## How it works

- Backend: Go, with gorilla/websocket for the feed, go-git to read HEAD, and fsnotify to watch the directory for TODO.md.
- Frontend: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in `static/`, embedded in the binary with `go:embed`.
- Events are kept in memory, the latest 100.

## Development

```bash
make build
go vet ./...
go test -race ./...
```

```
├── main.go              # Server, event hub and watchers
├── main_test.go         # Hub and HTTP tests
├── static/
│   ├── index.html       # Page
│   ├── app.js           # WebSocket client and UI logic
│   └── style.css        # Styles
├── CLAUDE.md            # Rules for Claude Code
├── TODO.md              # Task list, watched by ULTRATHINK
└── README.md
```
